label: Lean 4 (AOT)
note: Lean 4 native executables use reference counting and copy-on-write arrays. Tasks parallelize binary trees, spectral norm and Mandelbrot. Samples include startup, input, complete work/output and shutdown. General C leaves supply fixed-point formatting and PCRE2 compile/next-match results; application traversal, counts and replacements remain Lean.
release_note: This series measures Lean 4, whose first public milestone was released January 4, 2021. Stable 4.0.0 followed September 8, 2023. Earlier Lean generations are not measured here.
runtime_policy: Official Lean 4.35.0 arm64 release; standard native Task pool; strict floating point with contraction disabled; builds outside timing.
memory_policy: Lean reference counting and copy-on-write; PCRE2 objects have Lean external-object finalizers.
evidence_scope: Pinned source, toolchain, builds, executable hashes and load commands. Per-process loaded-image inventories were not captured.
